description: Delete a snapshot to free disk space. The snapshot is gone for good, so anything it was the only copy of can no longer be rolled back to — confirm with the customer first. Requires the "manage" scope. If confirm_token is absent from this connection's input schema, use a connection that exposes it or a supported customer-portal flow. A quote or confirmation request is not completion. IRREVERSIBLE — takes two calls: the first returns a confirm_token and changes nothing, the second repeats the same arguments plus confirm_token and executes.
name: impreza_vps_delete_snapshot
title: Delete VPS snapshot
